intent.proves: At least one user group holds a Read-or-higher grant on a backend area (Section entity).
intent.scope: UnifiedPermission rows with PermissionName Section and a group principal; levels are the sparse enum (Read = 4)

bindings.reason: get_area_permissions reads content website areas, not backend Section grants; no MCP read covers Section entities.
Admin permission read verb named in dw-data-access recipes; response projection not measured.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM UnifiedPermission WHERE PermissionName = 'Section' AND PermissionLevel >= 4 AND PermissionUserId NOT IN ('Anonymous','AuthenticatedFrontend','Administrator')
